programs.title: Howards End
programs.desc: Anthony Hopkins, Helena Bonham Carter and Emma Thompson star in James Ivory's adaptation of EM Forster's novel about two families, love, treachery and revenge.

programs.title: Deep Impact
programs.desc: Elijah Wood and Morgan Freeman star in the sci-fi disaster movie about impending meteorite-related disaster, attempts to destroy it, and possibly some cataclysmic havoc.

programs.title: The Fabelmans
programs.desc: Steven Spielberg's semi-autobiographical coming-of-age drama about a young man who dreams of reshaping the world through the medium of film. With Michelle Williams and Seth Rogen.

programs.title: Mean Streets
programs.desc: Scorsese's classic crime drama about the ordinary lives of mafiosi - the boredom, casual violence and shattered dreams - in Little Italy, with Harvey Keitel and Robert De Niro.

programs.title: Little Monsters
programs.desc: Undead comedy horror with Lupita Nyong'o. Can an infantile slacker, a diligent teacher and a deranged children's TV presenter rescue a school trip from a zombie outbreak? Head count.

programs.title: Santa Fe
programs.desc: Western starring Randolph Scott. Four brothers leave the defeated South to seek jobs as the US recovers from the Civil War. As one becomes a railwayman, the others turn to crime.

programs.title: The Guns of Fort Petticoat
programs.desc: Western. A Union army deserter sets out to turn his Texan hometown's womenfolk into sharpshooters in order to repel a Comanche attack. Starring Audie Murphy and Kathryn Grant.

programs.title: The Caine Mutiny
programs.desc: Oscar-nominated Humphrey Bogart, in one of his finest roles, stars in Edward Dmytryk's gripping drama as Captain Philip Queeg, in charge of a US Navy minesweeper during the war.

programs.title: The Mark of Zorro
programs.desc: Swashbuckling action-adventure starring Tyrone Power. An aristocrat dons his mask and cape to fight for the rights of the poor in 19th-century California. With Basil Rathbone.

programs.title: The Lost City
programs.desc: Comedy adventure with Sandra Bullock and Channing Tatum. When a romance novelist is kidnapped wearing a pink jumpsuit, her hapless cover model heads to the jungle to rescue her.
